newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to consider setting up loan collecting body.
newsitem.headline: MOF to consider setting up loan collecting body.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) will consider setting up a public organisation to recover problem loans at banks and other private financial institutions, a MOF official told reporters on Friday.
In the course of its deliberations, the ministry will work with existing agencies in charge of recovering assets from failed housing loan agencies, she said.

The issue was brought up by the heads of the Deposit Insurance Corp of Japan (DIC), the Housing Loan Administration Corp (HLAC) and the Resolution and Collection Bank Ltd (RCB) when they met with Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka this morning, she said.
The three agencies have already decided to set up a study group to review issues related to the establishment of such a public entity, and the ministry plans to support their work, she added.
"We would like to consider this issue, including the integration of the three existing agencies, over a medium-to-long term time span," she said.
